text:
Abyssal Lords
​
Introduction
Abyssal lords  are the best abyssal creatures task for both experience and gold. They are mainly killed for Slayer  tasks, the Senntisten collection log, combat  /  item experience, profit, and  / 
​
⬥ Abyssal lords tasks may be assigned by Mandrith.
⬥ Abyssal demons tasks may be assigned by Mandrith, Laniakea, Morvran, Kuradal, Duradel, Sumona, and The Raptor.
⬥ Demon cluster tasks may be assigned by Laniakea, and The Raptor.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Laniakea assigns almost twice as many.
⬥ For both abyssal demons and demon cluster tasks, each  counts as 5 kills.
​
Stats
⬥  level: 115 
⬥  XP per kill: 8,235 
⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~450 , ~398 , ~240 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~884  (Wilderness abyssal lords and beasts)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ ~45%  / ~55% 
⬥ Optimal  XP per hour: ~3.71M , ~3.28M , ~1.98M 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~3.98m  (Wilderness abyssal lords and beasts)
​
Desirable drops
⬥ Abyssal scourge 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.
⬥ Abyssal flesh 
⬥ Revenant drop enhancer 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only dropped if killed in the Wilderness.
​
Useful Items and Unlocks


















Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.

Items
⬥ Wilderness sword 4 
    • Allows for an easy teleport.
⬥ Demon horn necklace  and attuned ectoplasmator 
    • May be used to help sustain your prayer.
⬥ Dwarven siege engine 
    • Make sure to have the Restocking Cannon ability unlocked.
Other
⬥ Armour perked with Demon Slayer 
    • +7% damage against demons.
⬥ Infernal Puzzle Box (tier 6) 
    • 14% damage reduction and 9% damage increase whilst in the Wilderness.
        ⬩ This effect scales with the tier of your puzzle box.
    • Tier 6 allows you to put it in your tool belt.








​
Location and How to Get there
Abyssal lords can be fought in the Wilderness, the Senntisten Asylum, or the Sunken Pyramid.
​
Level 47 Wilderness

⬥ Use a  and teleport to the Wilderness herb patch.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Position yourself on the westernmost corner of the rock and walk 2 tiles north and 1 tile west.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place  1 tile west of the bottom skeleton.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using an alt, position yourself as shown here.
⬥ Abyssal lords and beasts can be fought simultaneously at this location.
⬥ Do not use Necromancy  at this location.
​
Senntisten Asylum

⬥ Use a  and teleport to Senntisten, then run north-east towards the asylum elevator.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once inside run to the final room, a gate key unlocks a shortcut.
​
Sunken Pyramid

⬥ Use a  and teleport to the Sunken Pyramid.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Relocating your house to Menaphos and using a teleport to house tablet also works.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place 5 abyssal lords in the small room, and position yourself 7 tiles south of the northern statue.
​
Method: AFK (all styles)
